Ok I watched a few of your videos there and went back through your channel. A few points (these are only imo obviously, sorry if they come off as harsh)

  • Recent content is too stale as you noted yourself. Also the videos are imo too short, if your doing a LP each vid should be longer (30 minutes minimum). I don't know if it's a youtube upload limit thing or you just decided to choose an arbitrary length but longer would be better (again imo)

  • Maybe throw in a few short sub 3min vids like you did earlier. Try and do quick challenges/tricks/cool mod vids, anything really that will make you not just another LP channel.

  • Who are you? That may sound silly but I clicked on a few random videos and all I got was the name of your channel. What are your names/nicknames? I couldn't tell who was talking half the time, there were no distinct personalities at all. Your conversations had zero structure and no connecting thread throughout. You were basically just reacting to what was going on in the game most of the time, it sounded like you were just talking half the time to fill up dead air.

  • This is related to the above point but your interactions seemed a bit forced. Again a conversation was not allowed to develop at any time, you were always rushing to say something, anything to beat back the silence. Thus I as a viewer have zero notion about who you are as people. This factor is pretty vital in any media, who am I watching, do I like these people, have they anything interesting to say that I maybe interested in sticking around to hear.

  • I would suggest that for future gaming sessions you make out a list of topics to talk about. I don't mean write out a whole script but a few bullet points about the game, what you like/hate about it, some interesting trivia/what other games the dev made etc etc. How does the game stack up against others in the genre. Have a discussion about the game whilst playing it, don't just react to whats happening on the screen.

  • Decide whether or not you want to make videos for you and your friends to enjoy or for the audience. You maybe having a good time now goofing around with your mates but that may not be enjoyable for a viewer. The good, interesting content on youtube only looks effortless through a lot of hard, sometimes not very enjoyable work.

  • If you want to succeed keep working at it, you can disregard everything I've said but if you want this to take off you have to at least keep trying. Don't expect success though, not because I don't think your not good enough but it does take a lot of luck to get that first viral vid that really boosts your channel.

Again feel free to ignore all this but I hope at least some of it helps.
